content.title: Is Dunkin’ open on Easter 2026?
content.text: BusinessDunkin' will be open on Easter 2026, which falls on Sunday, April 5.Patti Sapone | NJ.com Still need to pick up Easter treats? Dunkin’ has always been a go-to for holiday sweets with its themed MUNCHKINS and donuts. They often release Easter-themed offerings on the same week as the holiday, so these donuts and MUNCHKINS have become a staple at many holiday celebrations. However, because it’s a holiday, you may not be sure if you could make a last-minute Dunkin’ run on Sunday, April 5. Here’s what you should know about Dunkin’s store hours this Easter Sunday.Is Dunkin’ closed on Easter 2026?No, Dunkin’ is open all day on Easter this year.Many Dunkin’ shops are open from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. However, store hours vary by location so it’s best to confirm operating hours before stopping by. The chain tends to stay open on most holidays, including Easter, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day, but hours and closures also depend on the location. If you need to visit sooner, you can stop by on Good Friday (April 3), as well, because locations will be open.If you’re planning to visit Dunkin’ for Easter donuts or your go-to coffee order, you can find your local Dunkin’ here.Is Dunkin’ offering Easter deals in 2026? Dunkin’s hasn’t revealed their Easter deals or specialty treats yet, but they should land at stores this week. The chain didn’t announce its 50-count assortment in a Spring MUNCHKINS Bucket until five days before Easter Sunday 2025 along with its limited-edition Blueberry Sprinkle MUNCHKINS.But Dunkin’ did drop its April Fool’s Day free coffee deal on April 1 that will run from now until seven days after. The freebie is exclusive to Dunkin’ rewards members with promo code STILLNOTAJOKE.Cold brew and extra-large hot coffee are not included in the promotion this year, although cold brew was included last year. After your Dunkin’ run, you won’t be able to visit Costco or Lowe’s because they’ll be closed on Easter. However, you can stop by Walmart, especially while it’s offering a special Easter ham dinner bundle. Is Walmart open on Easter?
